tsc && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const code = 'import { createRequire } from "node:module";

export const {

  DEFAULT_MODEL,
  DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS,
  RuleScope,
  SlashMLAPIError,
  ProjectManager,
  MemoryClient,
  Memory,
  AsyncMemoryClient,
  AsyncMemory,
  SlashMLMemory,
  SlashMLClient,
  AsyncSlashMLMemory,
  AsyncSlashMLClient,
  extractCanonicalSlotKey,
  compileContrastiveRule,
  formatCacheAlignedPrompt,
} = cjs;

export default cjs;
'; fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.mjs', code);"
